scientific_integrity: Proof provided for all integers d>=2, all k>=1, and all 0<a<1. Numerical tests corroborate but do not establish the infinite theorem. Published Fourier-zero interlacing and analytic continuation are acknowledged as prior results; only the turning-point census and exact migration law are new claims.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to real radial zeros of uniform concentric Euclidean annuli with fixed outer radius; no independent priority or mathematical audit established. Bessel critical values are implicit.
title: Every indexed Fourier zero of a concentric annulus has exactly one fewer turning point than its index
